notes: Each specification version applies only to the contract expiry months listed in its source's launch calendar.
Contracts outside every verified window resolve as UNVERIFIED and are refused by normalization unless explicitly allowed.
To add a version, cite an MCX circular, record where the copy was obtained, and set applies_to_expiry_months from that circular.

MCX/MCXCCL/148/2025.title: Delivery & Settlement Procedure for GOLD TEN Contract (MCXCCL/C&S/058/2025)
MCX/MCXCCL/148/2025.issuer: Multi Commodity Exchange Clearing Corporation Ltd
MCX/MCXCCL/148/2025.retrieval_notes: Applies to GOLD TEN contracts expiring April 2025 onward. States the price basis is 999 purity.

specifications.name: Gold Mini
specifications.price_quote_text: Ex-Ahmedabad (inclusive of all taxes and levies relating to import duty, customs but excluding GST, any other additional tax, cess, octroi or surcharge as may be applicable)
specifications.quality_text: 995 purity. Serially numbered gold bars from LBMA approved suppliers or other suppliers approved by MCX.
specifications.price_basis_evidence: Quality specification is 995 purity, and a seller delivering 999 purity receives 'Rate of delivery * 999/995'. The quoted rate therefore refers to 995 fineness.
specifications.last_trading_day_text: 5th of contract expiry month. If 5th is a holiday then preceding working day.

specifications.name: Gold Ten (10 gram)
specifications.price_quote_text: Ex-Ahmedabad (inclusive of all taxes and levies relating to import duty, customs but excluding GST, any other additional tax, cess, octroi or surcharge as may be applicable)
specifications.quality_text: 999 purity. Serially numbered 10 gram gold from LBMA approved suppliers or other suppliers approved by MCX.
specifications.price_basis_evidence: MCXCCL/148/2025: 'The price of 10 Gram Gold is on the basis of 999 purity.' DDR is Ahmedabad 995 spot converted by * 999/995.
specifications.last_trading_day_text: Last calendar day of the contract expiry month. If last calendar day is a holiday, then preceding working day.
notes: Buyer pays Rs 300 per 10 g making charge over the DDR on delivery (MCXCCL/148/2025). Affects delivery economics, not the quoted price.
Staggered tender period: last 5 trading days in MCXCCL/148/2025 (Mar 2025) but last 3 trading days in MCX/TRD/456/2025 (Sep 2025).

specifications.name: Gold Guinea
specifications.price_quote_text: Ex-Ahmedabad (inclusive of all taxes and levies relating to import duty, customs but excluding GST, any other additional tax, cess, octroi or surcharge as may be applicable)
specifications.quality_text: 999 purity. Serially numbered Gold Guinea from LBMA approved suppliers or other suppliers approved by MCX.
specifications.price_basis_evidence: Quality specification is 999 purity, and the DDR is Ahmedabad 995 spot converted to 999 (* 999/995) then scaled to 8 g (* 8/10).
specifications.last_trading_day_text: Last calendar day of the contract expiry month. If last calendar day is a holiday then preceding working day.
notes: Older secondary sources describe a 995-purity Gold Guinea. Earlier contract periods may have a different price basis and are not verified.

specifications.name: Gold Petal
specifications.price_quote_text: Ex-Mumbai (inclusive of all taxes and levies relating to import duty, customs but excluding GST, any other additional tax, cess, octroi or surcharge as may be applicable)
specifications.quality_text: 999 purity. LBMA approved suppliers or other suppliers approved by MCX, with a serial-numbered certificate accompanying the 1 gram coin.
specifications.price_basis_evidence: Quality specification is 999 purity, and the DDR is Mumbai 995 spot converted to 999 (* 999/995) then scaled to 1 g (* 1/10).
specifications.last_trading_day_text: Last calendar day of the contract expiry month. If last calendar day is a holiday then preceding working day.
notes: Priced Ex-Mumbai while GOLDM, GOLDTEN and GOLDGUINEA are Ex-Ahmedabad. Location basis is not adjusted by normalization.
Tick size Rs 1 per 1 g equals Rs 10 per 10 g, ten times coarser than GOLDTEN per gram.

GOLDTEN.evidence: MCXCCL/148/2025 covers GOLD TEN contracts expiring April 2025 onward and cites launch circular MCX/TRD/134/2025 (2025-03-18, not read). Launch date 2025-04-01 reported consistently by secondary sources.
